title: Petition of A Yankee Line, Inc. of Concord and South Boston, Massachusetts, requesting the Department of Public Utilities to issue a 120-day temporary license, pursuant to G.L. c. 159A, § 5, as amended, for the operation of motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire over a specified route in Littleton, Acton, Concord, Lincoln, Lexington, Waltham, Weston, Newton, Brookline and Boston.
